known_issues: Build/deployment process hit a snag (AI hiccup) while applying UI dialog/tab changes

existing_features.title: Enable the disabled “Add” tab/entry point wherever it appears in dialogs and dialog-driven workflows (e.g., any Tabs trigger/segment/button labeled “Add” that is currently disabled), so users can open the add/create form without being blocked.

Remove transparency from all popout dialog boxes and forms by ensuring dialog surfaces, popovers, and form containers use fully opaque theme colors (no Tailwind opacity modifiers like /10, /20, /50 and no translucent/backdrop-blur styling on dialog content). Apply this consistently across all dialogs (e.g., client/product/quotation/company/user management/confirm/print preview dialogs) and any nested popovers used inside dialogs (e.g., select dropdown content).

new_feature_requests.summary: Enable the disabled “Add” tab across all dialogs
Remove transparency from all popout dialog boxes and forms

projectName: Enable disabled “Add” tab in dialogs and remove transparency from all popout dialogs/forms
